title: A novel pre-inflationary model in view of the lack of angular correlation of CMB
summary: In this paper we propose a novel unified cosmological model that connects a pre-inflationary epoch, starting at the Planckian time, with the onset of inflation within a single scalar-field framework. The pre-inflationary phase is characterized by a decelerated expansion with an increasing comoving Hubble horizon, followed by a gradually transition to an accelerated inflationary regime.
